title: Carry Gatsby develop improvements into the Papyrus port before launch
description: Anth.us launches on the Papyrus port (AnthusAI/Anth.us-Papyrus, branch feature/anthus-integration) on 2026-10-05. Carry every improvement that exists only on Gatsby develop into the port before launch: content-review and session copy edits (content/markus-native-markup synced with content main), About and decision-models copy, platform additions, Benchmarks page and menu entry, /posts/ excerpt headlines, content redirect pages, robots/sitemap entries, and the Biased-Decisions leaderboard at /biased-decisions/.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Ryan's decisions 2026-10-04: no SOC certification exists for Plexus (the bullet is already gone; nothing in content or the port claims it); Plexus vs plexus.anth.us positioning left as is; Plexus started October 2023, so solutions/Plexus.mdx display_date set to 'October 2023 - ongoing' (content PR #22, also merged into the Markus sync branch); no investor page (clients and customers only); Decision Models joins the menu (port MENU_LINKS, after AI Solutions). Provenance: claude-code / claude-opus-5-5.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Carried into the Papyrus port: Anth.us-Papyrus PR #4 merged into feature/anthus-integration (de18e9e), with anthus-site-content #21 (Markus branch synced with main, GLiDE converted) and #22 (Plexus October 2023) merged. Pages regenerated from a Gatsby develop build via bin/extract-page-html.py (all EXACT); menu gains Decision Models and Benchmarks; /posts/ excerpt headlines; content redirect stubs as 301s; Biased-Decisions leaderboard built into /biased-decisions/ after the Markus build. Verified: guarded build (195 pages, 1,532 leaderboard pages noindex) and production build (guards pass, robots and leaderboard sitemap correct, canonicals on anth.us); 10 tests pass; reviewer APPROVE on every PR. Watch on the first Amplify run: Node 22.x must be >= 22.12 for the leaderboard build. Provenance: claude-code / claude-opus-5-5.
